## 7. Anomalies across his papers (checked against the images, 24 Oct 2026)

Each anomaly is a mismatch between two papers. None is an accusation, and none is a handwriting or forgery point.

**A. Use on cross (documents only; take the answer)**

| # | The mismatch | Papers | Tab |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | **Two down payments.** S14 says that by about 1992 the Balanes had already paid a down payment (to Llamanzares). Yet his own side issued a receipt marked "Down payment," ₱20,000, on 6 January 2005, thirteen years later. Which was the down payment? | JA S14; Exh. 5, p. 3 | 1, 4 |
| A2 | **Estate tax: when, and with whose money.** His letter places the ₱2,000,000 estate-tax demand in 1991 and says it was settled then, "with the help of borrowed money from some of our friends in BIR." S24 says part of the Balane partial payments, which begin in October 2003, was used to pay estate tax. Both cannot describe the same payment. Ask only: "Which year did you pay estate tax, and from what money?" | Letter, p. 2; JA S24; Exh. 5, p. 2 | 2, 1, 4 |
| A3 | **He met the owners.** His letter says the heirs, Patricia included, came to his father's house twice in 1991 and spoke with him. S31 says the owners never came home. Use: the owners were known to him and reachable. That fits the SPA's requirement of prior consultation; do not argue that he lied. | Letter, p. 1; JA S31 | 2, 1 |
| A4 | **Nineteen years without a written appointment.** The Treasurer issued a clearance "upon request of MR. SALVADOR DELA FUENTE" on 25 May 1993. He signed receipts as "Von dela Fuente" from October 2003. The only paper naming him is dated 29 February 2012. | Tab 14, p. 36; Exh. 5, p. 2; 2012 paper | 14, 4, 7 |
| A5 | **The tax record stops where the Balane money starts.** His clearances end in November 1998. The Balane receipts run from October 2003 to February 2017. | Tab 14, pp. 29, 46; Exh. 5 | 14, 4 |
| A6 | **Asked in writing, answered five months later without the papers.** He received the request on 21 June 2025, with a reply due by 6 July 2025. His letter of 25 November 2025 enclosed Resolution No. 76-96 only. On 11 October 2025 he handed over 1991 to 1998 tax papers only. | CORR-007; letter; Tab 14 | 13, 2, 14 |
| A7 | **The 2,587 sq m existed on paper before the deed.** The Assessor's split-off is dated 28 April 2016, on a letter request and an SPA. The receipts first write "2587" in August 2016 (No. 0217). The deed is dated 29 September 2016, and "Full payment" is dated February 2017. | ARP 00246; Exh. 5, pp. 30, 33; Def. Exh. 6 | 5, 4, 11 |
| A8 | **"Others" did the transfer after his father died.** Cesar died on 21 June 2017. The partition is dated 15 March 2017 but cites a plan surveyed on 8 September 2020. Taxes were paid on 15 June 2020, and registration was on 23 November 2021. Ask who ordered the 2020 survey and who paid. | JA S26, S29; Exh. B, pp. 5 to 6; Def. Exh. 6, p. 2 | 1, 8, 11 |
